parameters.url: =https://services.leadconnectorhq.com/contacts/{{ $('New Member Webhook').first().json.body.contact_id || $('New Member Webhook').first().json.body.contactId || $('New Member Webhook').first().json.body.id }}

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ locationId: $('Config').first().json.LOCATION_ID, page: $json.page, pageLimit: $json.pageLimit, filters: [ { field: 'customFields.' + $('Config').first().json.FIELD_IDS.mugNumber, operator: 'exists' } ] }) }}

={{ JSON.stringify({ locationId: $('Config').first().json.LOCATION_ID, pipelineId: $('Config').first().json.PIPELINE.id, contactId: $('Pick Mug Number').item.json.contactId, pipelineStageId: $('Config').first().json.PIPELINE.available, name: $('Pick Mug Number').item.json.name + ' – Mug ' + $('Pick Mug Number').item.json.mug, status: 'open' }) }}

={{ (() => { const m = $('Pick Mug Number').item.json; const text = m.wasMember ? `[Craft Mountain perks] ${m.name} signed up again – keeps mug ${m.mug}` : m.alreadyHad ? `[Craft Mountain perks] New member ${m.name} (existing Toast guest) – mug ${m.mug}. Please prepare mug ${m.mug}.` : `[Craft Mountain perks] New member ${m.name} – mug ${m.mug}. Please prepare mug ${m.mug}.`; return JSON.stringify({ text, alertType: 'new_member', mug: m.mug, member: m.name }); })() }}

parameters.responseBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ contactId: $('Pick Mug Number').item.json.contactId, mug: $('Pick Mug Number').item.json.mug }) }}
